standard_prerequisites.name: The thresholds u_0 and u_1 of the section and their relation, together with the expansion estimate for sets in the product graph
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's section on Tutte obstructions and the size thresholds (source lines 655-700); the expansion estimate is the author's displayed inequality eq:expansion-log
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the two size bounds that the proof converts into exponential estimates, and the expansion used in the small-boundary case.

core_obligations: Count the small sets: the proof bounds the number of possible sets of size at most u_0 by exp(u_0 log(en/u_0)), which the definitions of u_0 and u_1 turn into exp(b/log d) (proof lines 781-785).

The large-boundary case: if the edge boundary of B is at least b log^2 d then at least half of those edges avoid U, and the probability that such sets exist is at most the product of the binomial coefficient, the counting factor and the absence probability, which is o(n^{-3}) (proof lines 787-790).

The small-boundary case: if the boundary is smaller, the author's counting lemma for sets with a small boundary bounds the number of candidates by exp(2b/log d), and the expansion estimate gives a boundary of at least alpha_M b, so the corresponding probability is at most exp(-alpha'_M b) (proof lines 791-795).
Conclusion: a union bound over all b at least u_1 proves the assertion (proof lines 796-797).
proof_roadmap: 先数出 |U| ≤ u_0 的可能集合个数 ≤ exp(u_0 ln(en/u_0)) = exp(b/ln d)（用 u_0、u_1 的定义与 b ≥ u_1）。
分两种情形：边界 ≥ b ln^2 d 时至少一半边界边避开 U，得概率 o(n^{-3})；边界较小时用集合计数引理给 exp(2b/ln d) 个候选，再用展开估计得边界 ≥ α_M b，概率 ≤ exp(-α'_M b)；最后对 b 求和。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement excludes small separators at the lower end of the window (author lemma at source lines 772-778, label lem:no-small-separator). The proof (source lines 780-797) is a two-case union bound whose inputs are the counting lemma for large sets with a small boundary and the expansion estimate: the large-boundary case is handled by a direct first-moment estimate reaching o(n^{-3}), and the small-boundary case by the counting lemma combined with the expansion estimate to reach exp(-alpha'_M b) (proof lines 787-795). The case split on the size of the edge boundary is what makes the estimate uniform in b. H2.
